candidates.name: West to East Pipeline (WEP)
candidates.from: Jebel Dhanna oil storage terminal, Ruwais area, western Abu Dhabi
candidates.to: Fujairah (Main Oil Terminal, Port of Fujairah, Gulf of Oman)

evidence.note: MEC Engineering Group (contractor to Marks Projects Management/ADNOC Onshore) portfolio page: EPCM/detailed engineering design services for 'West to East Pipeline (WEP) Project', Jebel Dhanna Industrial Area; project ongoing since 2023 (site offices, laydown area, warehouses).

METALFAB E&C project-award notice: automated pig launchers/receivers supplied for the ADNOC/ENPPI 'West to East Pipeline (WEP) Project' - confirms ADNOC Onshore as end client and ENPPI as EPC contractor for this named line.

Offshore Technology project-data profile: 'Jebel Dhanna-Fujairah oil pipeline', operator ADNOC, onshore crude pipeline, route Jebel Dhanna->Al Fujayrah, length 520 km, status upcoming/under development, expected to commence operations 2025 (superseded by later 2027 target reporting).
MEED trade coverage naming it 'West-East pipeline', confirms operational target of 2027, parallel to and roughly doubling the existing Habshan-Fujairah (ADCOP) corridor's bypass capacity.

48-inch diameter, 1.5mn b/d design capacity, under construction, targeting 2027; combined with existing ADCOP line (also 1.5mn b/d nameplate, recently run at 1.7-1.8mn b/d) would bring total Fujairah bypass capacity to ~3.3mn b/d.

Confirms ADNOC sponsorship, Habshan-area fields to Fujairah routing (Jebel Dhanna terminal upstream of Habshan on this new corridor per contractor sourcing), 2027 operational target, doubling of export capacity through Fujairah.
UAE leadership (Sheikh Khaled) directs ADNOC to fast-track this pipeline; ~$3bn cost, ~300km per some reporting, ~50% complete as of May 2026, targeting early 2027.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row reflects a second, currently-under-construction crude oil trunk line on the west Abu Dhabi-to-Fujairah corridor. Closest existing roster entry is P0553 (Bab-Habshan-Jebel Dhanna Oil Pipeline aka Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline/ADCOP; Habshan-Fujairah Oil Pipeline; status=operating; len=406.0; dia=48; cap=1,800,000) - same general corridor and purpose (bypassing the Strait of Hormuz to Fujairah) but that row is the pre-existing 2012-commissioned line. Contractor/EPC pages (MEC Engineering Group, METALFAB/ENPPI) independently confirm ADNOC Onshore has been executing a distinctly-named 'West to East Pipeline (WEP)' project since at least 2023, running Jebel Dhanna to Fujairah (~500-520 km per operator-adjacent project-data sourcing, vs. ADCOP's 406 km), which 2026 news coverage confirms is the same project now being fast-tracked toward a 2027 in-service date. This should be entered as a new construction-status row, distinct from and complementary to P0553, not a re-description of it.
